title: Workflow & Development Preferences
description: Define team workflow, TDD approach, commit strategy, and quality standards

questions.question: What development methodology should be followed?

options.label: Test-Driven Development (TDD)
options.description: Write tests first, then implement code (Red-Green-Refactor)

options.label: Test-After Development
options.description: Implement code first, then write tests

options.label: Behavior-Driven Development (BDD)
options.description: Write specifications in natural language, then tests

options.label: Flexible (No strict requirement)
options.description: Tests required but order is flexible

questions.question: What code coverage target should be enforced?

options.label: 95% or higher (Recommended)
options.description: Very high coverage, minimal untested code

questions.question: What commit message convention should be used?
Should manual verification checkpoints be required between phases?

options.label: Yes (Recommended)
options.description: Pause for user verification at end of each phase

questions.question: Should detailed git notes be attached to commits?

options.label: Yes (Recommended)
options.description: Attach detailed summaries with files, rationale, coverage

options.label: Only for checkpoints
options.description: Only phase checkpoints get git notes

questions.question: Should the application be smoke tested after each task?

options.label: Yes (Recommended)
options.description: Run application to ensure it starts without errors

options.label: Only after phases
options.description: Smoke test only at phase boundaries

questions.question: Any additional workflow preferences or team conventions?
questions.placeholder:
Example:
- Use branches for each track
- Require code review before merging
- Run linter (pylint, eslint) before commit
- Format code with black/prettier
